desc: A silhouette of a female character standing in a deep-sea environment, slightly side-facing with crossed legs, elegant seductive pose, showing a slim waist and curved back. She wears a tight, semi-transparent deep-blue combat suit with lace trim on the shoulders and waist, revealing the curves of the upper body and waist. Her lower body is covered by a high-waisted, knee-high stocking with a deep-blue tight pants, with an open split at the thigh, showing long legs. A semi-transparent pearl-white cloak with glowing blue fringes flows around her. A glowing tidal sigil hovers at her chest, with the number 'T-04-01' engraved on it. Her pose is elegant yet powerful, with glowing blue patterns on her arms and legs, and a tidal wave-like effect radiating from the cloak's edges.
